temporal_notes: Mosquitoes collected every six weeks over a one-year period from December 2007 to November 2008
source_text: Overall 13,602 mosquitoes including 115 An. gambiae sensu lato (s.l.)... The 1014F kdr allele was present in both molecular M and S forms. The frequency of this mutation was respectively 0.47 (95%CI 0.37-0.57) and 0.61 (95%CI 0.43-0.80) in the M and S forms.
